# ===================================================================== # Recurring B2B orders: ONE daily cron for every recurrence. # Replaces crons 150 / 155 / 156 / 157. A template is copied when its # period has elapsed since its last copy (or since its own order date). # =====================================================================
# ---- Constants ------------------------------------------------------- LOCAL_TZ = 'Europe/Madrid'
# code : stable key written in "Documento origen" - never rename once in use # start : first day this cron may generate (= next run of the old cron) RECURRENCES = [ {'code': 'MENSUAL', 'tag_id': 1, 'months': 1, 'days': 0, 'start': datetime.date(2026, 10, 27), 'confirm_and_invoice': False}, {'code': '90D', 'tag_id': 2, 'months': 0, 'days': 90, 'start': datetime.date(2026, 12, 26), 'confirm_and_invoice': False}, {'code': '15D', 'tag_id': 4, 'months': 0, 'days': 15, 'start': datetime.date(2026, 10, 27), 'confirm_and_invoice': False}, {'code': 'RENTING', 'tag_id': 3, 'months': 1, 'days': 0, 'start': datetime.date(2026, 10, 27), 'confirm_and_invoice': True}, ]
TEMPLATE_STATE = 'sale' SAVEPOINT = 'recurring_order' NOTE_SUBTYPE = 'mail.mt_note'
# ---- Setup ----------------------------------------------------------- SaleOrder = env['sale.order'] Tag = env['crm.tag'] local_tz = timezone(LOCAL_TZ) utc_tz = timezone('UTC') today = datetime.datetime.now(local_tz).date()
# Every recurrence tag: none is ever copied to a duplicate recurrence_tag_ids = [] for recurrence in RECURRENCES: recurrence_tag_ids.append(recurrence['tag_id']) all_recurrence_tags = Tag.browse(recurrence_tag_ids).exists()
created = [] not_invoiced = [] failed = []
# ---- Main loop ------------------------------------------------------- for recurrence in RECURRENCES: code = recurrence['code'] tag = Tag.browse(recurrence['tag_id']).exists() if not tag: log('Recurring orders %s: crm.tag %s not found, skipped' % (code, recurrence['tag_id']), level='error') continue
period = dateutil.relativedelta.relativedelta(months=recurrence['months'], days=recurrence['days'])
templates = SaleOrder.search([ ('tag_ids', 'in', tag.ids), ('state', '=', TEMPLATE_STATE), ])
for template in templates: origin = '%s · %s' % (template.name, code)
# Due date: one period after the last copy (or the template itself), never before start last_copy = SaleOrder.search([('origin', '=', origin)], order='create_date desc', limit=1) anchor_utc = last_copy.create_date if last_copy else template.date_order anchor = utc_tz.localize(anchor_utc).astimezone(local_tz).date() due_date = max(anchor + period, recurrence['start']) if today < due_date: continue
# One savepoint per copy: a failing order is rolled back alone, the rest are kept env.cr.execute('SAVEPOINT ' + SAVEPOINT) try: # Work in the template's company (journal, taxes, sequence) source = template.with_company(template.company_id)
# copy() already resets state to draft; drop every recurrence tag in the same call new_order = source.copy(default={ 'origin': origin, 'tag_ids': [Command.set((template.tag_ids - all_recurrence_tags).ids)], })
summary = 'Pedido generado automáticamente como duplicado de %s (%s).' % (template.name, tag.name)
if recurrence['confirm_and_invoice']: new_order.action_confirm() invoices = new_order.with_context(raise_if_nothing_to_invoice=False)._create_invoices() if invoices: summary += ' Confirmado y con %s factura(s) en borrador.' % len(invoices) for invoice in invoices: invoice.message_post( body='Factura generada automáticamente para %s (%s).' % (new_order.name, tag.name), subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, ) else: summary += ' Confirmado, pero sin líneas facturables: no se ha creado factura.' not_invoiced.append(new_order.name)
new_order.message_post(body=summary, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE)
env.flush_all() # surface DB errors inside the savepoint, not after it env.cr.execute('RELEASE SAVEPOINT ' + SAVEPOINT) created.append('%s -> %s' % (origin, new_order.name)) except Exception as error: env.cr.execute('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ' + SAVEPOINT) env.invalidate_all() failed.append('%s: %s' % (origin, error))
# ---- Report (only on days with activity) ------------------------------ if created: log('Recurring orders: %s created -> %s' % (len(created), ', '.join(created)), level='info') if not_invoiced: log('Recurring orders: confirmed without invoice -> %s' % ', '.join(not_invoiced), level='warning') if failed: log('Recurring orders: %s failed -> %s' % (len(failed), ' | '.join(failed)), level='error')
Recurring sales confirmed sales, draft invoice

# Available variables: # - env: environment on which the action is triggered # - model: model of the record on which the action is triggered; is a void recordset # - record: record on which the action is triggered; may be void # - records: recordset of all records on which the action is triggered in multi-mode; may be void # - time, datetime, dateutil, timezone: useful Python libraries # - float_compare: utility function to compare floats based on specific precision # - log: log(message, level='info'): logging function to record debug information in ir.logging table # - _logger: _logger.info(message): logger to emit messages in server logs # - UserError: exception class for raising user-facing warning messages # - Command: x2many commands namespace # To return an action, assign: action = {...} # Buscar pedidos de venta con la etiqueta ID=3 y estado 'sale' orders = env['sale.order'].search([ ('tag_ids', 'in', [3]), ('state', '=', 'sale') ])
for order in orders: # Duplicar el pedido new_order = order.copy()
# Ajustar campos en el duplicado new_order.write({ 'state': 'draft', # aseguramos que esté en borrador 'tag_ids': [(3, 3)] # quitar etiqueta ID=3 })
# Confirmar el pedido duplicado new_order.action_confirm()
# Crear factura (en borrador) invoices = new_order._create_invoices()
# Agregar mensaje a la factura if invoices: for inv in invoices: inv.message_post( body=f"Esta factura fue generada automáticamente como renting de {order.name}." )
# Agregar mensaje en el chatter del pedido duplicado new_order.message_post( body=f"Este pedido fue generado automáticamente como renting de {order.name}, confirmado y con factura generada." )
